sections.heading: 6. Price
a) Proposal Pricing Form

internal_notes.issue: General track pricing mixes fixed monthly retainer tasks (G1, G2) with annual one-time items (G3–G7). Per pricing rules only the one-time items count against the $75,000 annual ceiling check (landing at ~65%), but the monthly retainer fees, annualized, add materially to true annual cost and could push the real total near or past the $75,000 ceiling. Sonja should confirm the monthly rates against the full annual math before this goes out.

Quantities are proposal-stage assumptions: 4 videos/year, 10 print pieces, 2 decks, 15 print/mailing pieces for the young adult campaign, and all staffing hour estimates. These should be validated with workNet DuPage at kickoff and adjusted via scope addendum if the actual cadence differs.

As-needed ad placement (S12) has no committed media budget in the RFP, so it could not be priced or run through the 85/15 media model. Flag to Ella whether we want to propose a placeholder media allowance or leave fully as-needed/authorized separately.

Buyer form only requests a single hourly rate per track (Part 1: rate only; Part 2: rate and hours), not a task-by-task price sheet. We answered Part 1 with a reference blended rate (Account Manager) since General track work is deliverable-based, and Part 2 with the blended rate/hours derived from the staffed Young Adult tasks. Writer should confirm this framing reads clearly against the literal form language.
